verdict.rationale: Adyen documents Adyen-generated reports for bookkeeping and reconciliation of funds, but they are framed for the platform operator rather than for sellers to use themselves. Configurable payouts provide some context for payout reconciliation. Nothing in the evidence shows sellers getting self-serve access to their own statements or exports, so this only glancingly meets the story. Missing for 10: seller-facing self-serve statements or embedded reporting UI, per-seller payout reconciliation reports, bookkeeper-ready export formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
